Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com

Subject: Acme Analytics — Redwood marketplace inquiry

Hi Camila —

I found Redwood on the cloud marketplace listing and wanted to reach out. We’re evaluating inference platforms to power faster, cheaper LLM features in our analytics product (mainly text summarization & entity extraction at scale).

Quick background: Acme Analytics is a 40-person startup running primarily on AWS. We have an internal ML infra team but want something managed for production inference — low latency and predictable cost are priorities.

Would love a short intro + demo to see how Redwood handles throughput/latency and what Dedicated or Marketplace options look like. Are you available for a 30-min demo next week? Our CTO (cc’d) and a senior SWE will join.

Best,
Jessica Liu
Head of Product
Acme Analytics

Two quick asks so I can tailor the demo:
- Primary traffic profile: bursty interactive vs sustained batch?
- Current budget / target cost per 1k requests (if you have a ballpark)

I’m available for 30 minutes on the following slots (Pacific time):
- Wed Jul 8, 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Wed Jul 8, 2:00–2:30 PM PT
- Thu Jul 9, 11:00–11:30 AM PT

If none of those work, send a couple of preferred times and I’ll match. I’ve attached a short platform overview to help prep.

Calendar link to pick a time directly: https://app.redwood.com/calendar/evt/rdw-acme-83

Looking forward to it — cc’ing Marissa from Solutions in case we want to bring a senior engineer for the session.

Thanks,
